item.title: King leads Remembrance service at the Cenotaph
item.body: The King led a solemn Remembrance service at the Cenotaph in central London. Wreaths were laid as 10,000 armed forces veterans, including 12 from World War Two, paid tribute.

photo.credit: White House / Public domain, Wikimedia Commons

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🇬🇧 King leads Remembrance service at the Cenotaph

The King led a solemn Remembrance service at the Cenotaph in central London. Wreaths were laid as 10,000 armed forces veterans, including 12 from World War Two, paid tribute.

Source: BBC | Image: White House / Public domain, Wikimedia Commons
UK Daily Briefing | 8 November, 13:53
